newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates executes option for two Boeing 777s.
newsitem.headline: Emirates executes option for two Boeing 777s.

text.p: Emirates airline said on Thursday it had signed a deal to execute an option to buy two Boeing 777 aircraft.
In a statement, Emirates said the aircraft will be delivered in October and November next year.
The two planes will be powered by Rolls-Royce Trent 892 engines, like the previous seven planes ordered by Emirates -- the last of which will be delivered next month.
The deal was signed in Dubai on Thursday by Emirates chairman Sheikh Ahmed bin Saeed al-Maktoum and Boeing's regional director for contracts David Doucette.
Emirates still has an option for another five 777s under a previous agreement.
"We have taken the decision to purchase these two aircraft in response to buoyant trading conditions, and in response to the need for aircraft to meet our future expansion plans," Sheikh Ahmed said.
The two aircraft coming next year will both be Boeing 777-200 increased gross weight versions capable of long-range flights.
